service.description: Answers an id (a Shopify order id or name, a HotWax order or return id, a NetSuite number, any spelling) from what Darpan already holds: the ID index's records that carry it, the records they connect to, and the tenant's open findings on any of them. Calls no connected system; an id no Darpan read has seen yet comes back notSeen.

parameter.name: value
parameter.description: The id as the person gave it.

parameter.name: lookup
parameter.description: {value, records: [{systemCode, systemEnumId, connectionId, recordKind, recordKey, ids, foundBy, indexedAt}], findings, notSeen, capped, cappedReason}
